shard_desc: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时，受到伤害减少25%
proto_desc: Takes 35% less damage from Super-effective moves.
proto_expanded: Reduces damage from super-effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction.

shard_desc: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时，受到伤害减少25%
proto_desc: Takes 35% less damage from Super-effective moves.
proto_expanded: Reduces damage from super-effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction.

proto_desc: Normal moves become Steel. Steel resists Ghost and Dark.
proto_expanded: Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Steel-type. If the user is Steel-type it resists Ghost and Dark, otherwise it gains Steel STAB.

shard_desc: 对妖精属性精灵造成伤害+50%
proto_desc: Deals 1.5x damage to Fairy. Takes 0.5x damage from Fairy.
proto_expanded: Deals 1.5x damage to Fairy-type Pokemon and takes 0.5x damage when attacked by Fairy-type Pokemon. Based on attacker/defender Pokemon types, not move types. The damage reduction is multiplicative with other sources.

shard_desc: 变色+变换自如+毛皮大衣+冰鳞粉
proto_desc: Color Change + Protean + Fur Coat + Ice Scales.
proto_expanded: Changes type to resist attacks before getting hit, changes type to match moves before landing a hit (activating once per turn), halves physical damage, and halves special damage. Damage reduction is multiplicative with other sources.
Reduces damage from super effective attacks by 35%. Multiplicative with other damage reduction sources. Boosts the user's accuracy by 1.2x. Removes Ghost-typing on target when landing an attack.

Boosts sound-based moves by 30%. Single-target sound moves gain spread targeting to hit both opposing Pokemon. Does not spread with multihit moves. Also boosts the user's sound moves by another 30% and reduces incoming sound move damage by 50%. Damage reduction is multiplicative with other sources.

Halves all incoming physical attack damage. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction. Also grants immunity to all non-attack damage sources including entry hazards, weather damage, status conditions, and recoil.

shard_desc: 对方造成伤害取最低随机数，受到击中要害伤害为1/4
proto_desc: Foes min roll. Takes 1/4 damage from crits.
proto_expanded: Opponents deal minimum damage rolls when attacking, forcing 85% damage instead of 85-100% variance. Critical hits against this Pokemon deal only 25% of their normal damage instead of 150-200%.

shard_desc: 受到接触类招式伤害减少为1/4，受到火属性招式伤害4倍
proto_desc: Quarters contact damage taken. 4x weak to Fire-type moves.
proto_expanded: Reduces damage from contact moves by 75%. Fire-type moves to deal x4 damage to the user. Multiplicative with other forms of damage reduction.

Halves damage from Fire-type moves. Immune to burn damage and Attack drops from burn status. Boosts contact moves by adding 20% of the user's Defense stat to attack calculations. Prevents paralysis and immediately cures the status if inflicted on the user.

Converts all Normal-type moves into Poison-type moves and grants STAB for Poison-type moves. If the user is Poison-type their Poison moves have 10% toxic chance. Amplifies the user's sound moves by 30% and reduces incoming sound move damage by 50%. Damage reduction is multiplicative with other sources.
Boosts Speed by 50% during rain. Reduces damage by 30% when moving before the opponent. Works when the user switches in mid-turn.

shard_desc: 5回合内所有招式对该精灵都算作效果不好
proto_desc: Resists all attacks for three turns on first entry.
proto_expanded: On entry, all attacks received by the user are considered not very effective for 3 turns. Deactivates when switching out.

Reduces all incoming damage by 50% when the Pokemon is at max HP. Multiplicative with other sources of damage reduction. Has a 30% chance to inflict poison on contact moves, both when attacking and being attacked.

shard_desc:
在雾中陷入愤怒,愤怒时受到伤害减半.
进入迷雾时陷入愤怒.当使用者愤怒时,所有受到的伤害降低50%,且不会受到愤怒伤害.
proto_desc: Enrages in fog, reduces damage taken by 20% when enraged.
proto_expanded: Becomes enraged when entering fog. All incoming damage is reduced by 20% when the user is enraged and it takes no damage from enrage.

shard_desc:
坚壁 + 钢能力士.
使用者无视大多数增加伤害或额外攻击次数的特性.将使用者的一般属性招式变为钢属性.如果使用者是钢属性,它抵抗幽灵和钢属性；否则,它获得钢属性的本系加成.
proto_expanded: The user ignores most abilities that increase damage or hit additional times. Changes the user's Normal-type moves to Steel-type. If the user is Steel-type it resists Ghost and Steel, otherwise it gains Steel STAB.

shard_desc: 化石 + 岩石属性招式无视特性.
减弱受到的第一次攻击,并降低对手的攻击.
proto_desc: First hit taken deals 35% less damage, then lowers Atk by -1.

shard_desc: 受到的所有攻击伤害降低10%.被抵抗时降低20%.
proto_desc: Takes 15% less damage from attacks, 30% if resisted.
proto_expanded: Takes 15% less damage from all attacks. Takes 30% less damage from resisted attacks.
